scope: Second targeted review of admin/seller rental booking lifecycle: partial returns, inspection/cleaning, refund receipts, provider refund status and mobile/desktop operation controls.

findings.finding: Partial returns remained on Receive even when a returned piece awaited inspection or cleaning, and cleaning selection included uninspected pieces.
findings.resolution: Share eligible-piece selection across scanner/checklists/inspection/cleaning/loss actions. Prioritize available inspection and cleaning, retain Receive for outstanding pieces, and reject stale piece choices before submitting. Show piece return counts in the booking summary.

findings.finding: Handover, inspection, cleaning release, customer request review and reopening required backend notes, but simple booking controls did not validate those notes before submission.
findings.resolution: Require the relevant acknowledgement/condition/decision/review note before enabling the operation. Preserve operation identity and form data for actual network retries.

findings.finding: Refund controls could appear before return inspection or in a closed settlement, while refunding a cancelled line in an otherwise active booking was omitted.
findings.resolution: Match frontend eligibility to inspected returns, cancellation/expiry and active bookings with cancelled lines. A closed settlement must first be explicitly reopened with a reason.

findings.finding: Refund entry checked global entitlement but not the remaining balance of its selected original receipt; unresolved provider refunds were easy to overlook.
findings.resolution: Show remaining refundable amount per original receipt, reserve pending/processed refunds and exclude failed ones, disable exhausted receipts, validate the selected receipt limit, display pending provider amount and waiting status, and prevent closing until the server confirms settlement.

findings.finding: Bookings with no available operation displayed an irrelevant Note and disabled Save update; inspection choices used raw enums.
findings.resolution: Hide the empty operation form in the simple booking view and use readable inspection labels while keeping backend enum values unchanged.

flows: Settlement closure only after provider confirmation

optionalImprovements: Add a dedicated pending customer request filter so cancellation, date-change and dispute requests can be reviewed without opening every booking.
Use automatic detail refresh on focus/payment updates, reconciling fresh server revisions while protecting unsaved notes and retaining idempotent operations.
outstanding: Deploy the local frontend changes and the canonical backend guard from the preceding review.
Validate actual hosted OTP, managed licence, transaction/index readiness, payment/webhook/refund providers and persistent media.
Confirm actual physical inventory, rental rates, merchant cancellation/deposit policy and staff operational ownership.
